name: materials-statistics
description: Use when auditing, revising, or drafting statistical reporting for materials-science manuscripts: sample-size and replicate definitions (specimens vs repeated measurements), ANOVA for factorial and Taguchi designs, response-surface regression, multiple-comparison corrections, effect sizes and uncertainty, error-bar and figure-statistics alignment, and reviewer comments about statistics. Trigger for statistics review, statistical analysis section, p-values, replicate counts, 统计审查、统计分析、 统计方法、方差分析、多重比较、样本量、重复数、置信区间、效应量、图注统计、 审稿人统计意见. Do not use for full raw-data reanalysis unless the user supplies data and explicitly asks for computation, for figure rendering, or for experiment planning without a reporting question.
